stations.title: Ifan
stations.say: Which breeds do we see most?

stations.title: animals
stations.text: Every count so far covers the whole table.
stations.note: One number, not one per breed.

captions: Ifan wants to know which breeds the practice sees, to order the right leaflets.
A count squeezes the whole table into one number, so every breed is lumped together.
You split the rows into groups, pick and sort the groups by their totals, in four tasks.
Now each species and breed gets its own count, and Ifan orders what he needs.
Same records, now with a figure for every group.
